_comment: The whole voiceover script. Each scene is a list of lines; each line is one voice clip (it is spoken, never shown). `speech` (optional) is what the voice says when it should differ from `text`. `pad` (optional) adds extra seconds after the line so an animation can finish. Scene ids must match SCENE_COMPONENTS in src/SweetPotatoVideo.tsx; the scenes time their animations against these lines, so if you add or remove a line, check that scene too.

lines.text: 大家好！今天教大家一個保存地瓜葉的小妙招。
從菜園剛剪下來的地瓜葉枝條，
如果就這樣放著，很快就會軟掉、枯萎。
最有效的方法，就是把它插在水裡，
這不僅能讓地瓜葉保持新鮮，
過了幾天，它甚至會開始發根，
還會長出新的葉子，繼續生長！
簡單又有效，大家也來試試看吧！
